{{Quote|Immediately thereafter the Sith began a full assault on the Republic allies in the Aparo sector, which fell before the Republic fleet even arrived.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
The '''assault on the Aparo sector''' was an offensive launched by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the early days of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Following the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|return]] to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was slow to mobilize an effective defense. As a result, the Republic's allies in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] were wholly undefended and one of the Empire's first targets. The Imperial assault on the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was a success, forcing the Republic's allies to give in to the Sith and change allegiances.

==Prelude==
[[File:Republic_Aparo.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Republic's allies in the Aparo sector]]
{{Quote|The Emperor wanted us to witness the full might of his forces before he attacked.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
Following centuries of seclusion in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the ancient [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and waged war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] first reappeared on the fringes of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], where a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]] engaged and destroyed a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic envoy]] from the Republic, initiating the [[Great Galactic War]]. The Sith's next target was the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], a region of the Tingel Arm that was allied with the Republic.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==The assault==
The Imperial assault was swift and effective, beginning and ending before the Republic was able to mount an organized defense of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the Aparo sector with [[Imperial soldier|Sith soldiers]] and [[Sith war droid Mark II|war droids]], quickly overrunning the native defenders. As a result of the Republic's inability to combat the Empire, the governments of the Aparo sector abandoned their ally and defected to the Sith Empire.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Empire_Aparo.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The people of the Aparo sector after defecting to the Empire]]
{{Quote|The Republic fleet suddenly found itself in enemy territory, fighting desperately on all sides.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
Following the assault on the Aparo sector and the defection of the governments of Aparo, the Republic attempted to launch an offensive against the Empire throughout the Tingel Arm. However, the Republic's former allies on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] and [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]],<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> and [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]],<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> had also fallen to the Sith. Much like the Aparo sector, these worlds had become subservient to the Empire.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> As a result, instead of combating the Empire alongside the natives of these worlds, the Republic fleet was caught within enemy territory, fighting for survival.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> These opening battles of the Great Galactic War put the Republic on the defensive for several decades and contributed to the Empire's ultimate victory [[3653 BBY|twenty-eight years later]].<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref> Following the close of the war, the assault on the Aparo sector was included in [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]'s recounting of the beginning of the Sith invasion.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault on the Aparo sector first appeared in the sixth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', titled [[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|''Onslaught of the Sith Empire'']]. The timeline is a series of web videos presented as historical accounts on the story behind the [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The installments are available on the game's [http://swtor.com official site] and are narrated by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master Gnost-Dural, who is voiced by actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="News" />
